description:
Context: plugins/adlc-copilot/README.md lists build-gate context fitness without noting that it is currently inert on Copilot (#810); skills/adlc-ticket/SKILL.md and skills/adlc/SKILL.md reference adlc-runner run p0/p1 instead of adlc run p0/p1 (#812) and defer to docs/interrogation-protocol.md without a followable GitHub URL (#813).
Requirements:
1. Update plugins/adlc-copilot/README.md capability table and Enforcement posture section to state that build-gate is currently inert on Copilot because the CLI exposes no session transcript (#810).
2. Replace adlc-runner run p0 and adlc-runner run p1 with adlc run p0 and adlc run p1 in plugins/adlc-copilot/skills/adlc-ticket/SKILL.md and plugins/adlc-copilot/skills/adlc/SKILL.md (#812).
3. Link docs/interrogation-protocol.md to its canonical GitHub URL in plugins/adlc-copilot/skills/adlc-ticket/SKILL.md and plugins/adlc-copilot/skills/adlc/SKILL.md (#813).
4. Add regression assertions in plugins/adlc-copilot/test/contract.test.mjs.
title: fix(adlc-copilot): document build-gate inertness, adlc run p0/p1, and interrogation-protocol URL (#810, #812, #813)
